messages.subject: remove commented-out code
parts:
I'm also finding piles of code that's commented out
and left behind. For example, multi_student_t had
dozens of such lines. I find this VERY confusing when
browsing code and am going to just erase any commented
out lines that I find.

Please please, if you change the code and comment out
lines in the interim development phase, please just get
rid of them when you commit.

If you want to leave breadcrumbs behind, make notes
to yourself or leave comments in the code. If you must,
comments around commented-out bits of code, but only if
the commented-out code is part of the comment.
As in,

// above is optimized form of following:
// blah = ...;

Thanks.

- Bob
